in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: [ Text of section as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43 effective August 1, 2025.  See 2025, 9, Sec. 136.  For text effective until August 1, 2025, see above.]

result.prior_version_note: Before August 1, 2025, the section only required that anyone in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee be a licensed broker or salesman. It did not limit brokers to contracting with one side and did not say which party pays the fee. That licensing sentence carries over into the current text; the start date of that licensing component is not stated in the documents.
